items.difficulty_reason: The statement computes the derived tensor product of a complex along the projection from the polynomial algebra onto the base, obtaining the direct sum of the complex and its shift (statement lines 21217-21226). The proof chooses a K-flat resolution by flat modules, encodes the projection as the double complex given by multiplication by the variable, checks that its total complex is a K-flat resolution of the original complex because multiplication by the variable is injective with cokernel the original term, and then evaluates the tensor product with the base in a displayed chain of equalities which reduces to the direct sum of the resolution and its shift (proof lines 21228-21255). The replacement of the complex by the carefully chosen total complex is the device that makes the computation legitimate. The counted span refers five times, four times to results of this chapter and once to a base change statement of another chapter, all carried as navigation stubs.
